newsitem.title: UK: U.S. drug stocks in London dive on Pharmacia gloom.
newsitem.headline: U.S. drug stocks in London dive on Pharmacia gloom.

text.p: U.S. stocks in London were broadly flat on Friday ahead of the release of key U.S. producer price and retail sales data but pharmaceutical stocks took a dive on disappointment about Pharmacia & Upjohn results, traders said.
"It's pretty quiet before the data but drug stocks have taken a beating. We'd expected third quarter earnings at Pharmacia to be 20 percent higher," one dealer said.

Pharmacia said earlier on Friday it expected earnings per share before non-recurring charges for the third quarter to be close to the $0.44 reported a year-earlier. The stock was down three dollars in London at $38-3/8, traders said.
Other drug stocks fell in sympathy, with Merck down $1-3/8 at $68-1/4 and Pfizer off $1-1/2 at $79-1/2.
"Otherwise it's quiet and if PPI and retail sales come in as expected, we could be looking for a slight rally on the Dow," a dealer said. The Dow closed 8.95 points lower at 5,921.67.

September producer price and retail sales data are due at 1230 GMT. Dealers said they would welcome a more significant correction in the U.S. market to revive interest in what one called the hesitant market.
"We get the feeling people are waiting for an excuse to sell off on the bond market and are looking for a rate rise," a dealer said.
